name: waterloo-website
description: A basic local website for The Waterloo in Louisville, Colorado.

scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check content.js && node --check schedule.js && node --check server.mjs && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/check-security.mjs
